title: Diana Shnaider edges Alex Eala in 3 sets in Japan
summary: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala lost to third seed Diana Shnaider, 6-2, 6-7(5), 4-6, in the quarterfinals of the Toray Pan Pacific Open on Center Court in Tokyo.
